gloss: clerical work; office work; administrative tasks

definitions.gloss: clerical work; office work; administrative tasks
definitions.explanation: Routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, correspondence, and document preparation. A compound of {事務|じむ} (office affairs; clerical duties) and {作業|さぎょう} (work; tasks).

examples.japanese: {事務作業|じむさぎょう}に{追|お}われている。
{事務作業|じむさぎょう}を{効率化|こうりつか}したい。
examples.english: I want to make the clerical work more efficient.

examples.japanese: {午前中|ごぜんちゅう}は{会議|かいぎ}が{多|おお}いので、{事務作業|じむさぎょう}は{午後|ごご}にまとめてやっている。
examples.english: Since there are many meetings in the morning, I batch my clerical work in the afternoon.

notes:
A compound of {事務|じむ} (office affairs) and {作業|さぎょう} (work; tasks). Refers to the routine paperwork and administrative tasks that are part of most office jobs. This is a very common word in Japanese workplaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}に{追|お}われる: to be chased by clerical work; to be swamped with paperwork
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}を{効率化|こうりつか}する: to streamline clerical work
- {事務作業|じむさぎょう}をこなす: to handle clerical tasks
- {日常|にちじょう}の{事務作業|じむさぎょう}: daily office work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {事務|じむ}: office work; clerical duties — the shorter, more general term
- デスクワーク: desk work — loanword covering all work done at a desk
- {雑務|ざつむ}: miscellaneous tasks — less structured routine work
- {書類|しょるい}{仕事|しごと}: paperwork — specifically dealing with documents
